property_summary: For any caller who is the current owner, calling setOwner(...) succeeds and returns true (the reference always returns true on successful calls); the mutant removes the explicit return so callers can observe a different returned value (false/0) even though the call succeeds.
change_summary: Remove the explicit return statement so the function has no return value despite its signature (compiles in 0.8 with implicit default return), causing callers to observe a different returned value (false/0) compared to original true.
